title: Genpire
description: Made with passion, not greed. Pioneers of the community. We're not the copiers, we're the ones getting copied.
body:
![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eafe33d4735b65d7bb755071be8e1d303d305792.jpeg)


# Welcome to Genpire, the modern Gen-PvP server!
**We feature custom items, PvP optimizations and leaderboards!
Can you become number one?**

**IP:** `genpire.minehut.gg`

**We don't feature crates, lootboxes or other forms of P2W Gambling**


It all started back in 2025. We were bored of other servers just being a copy paste of the next, and new seasons starting every week to satisfy their dying community. We decided to be different. Our game was balanced for long-running seasons, and we cut down on ranks to not make them too OP. 

**Our custom items:**
- Shield Bubble: forms a 5 block diameter bubble around you. (We invented this, then got copied)
- Explosive Crossbow: deals quick damage in a radius
- Golden Shield: totem + shield in one
- Void Trap: teleports you and another player to a private arena with strength 3 for 30 seconds
- Protection 5 & Sharpness 6

![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dca404177f1393b14bd614f2a6c58e661664143.jpeg)
